'''R4-00''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who belonged to [[Seren Song]]. He accompanied her on a mission to [[Oaka Prime]]. He was destroyed by [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]] in the year [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
